items.notes: Closes watch item W-261108-06. rp.pl gives conflicting Pb95 figures (5.60 vs 6.04) and diesel 7.16; check Monitor Polski.
items.text: The fuel price caps continue: the Energy Minister published new maximum prices valid from Nov 10 — petrol 95 at 6.04 zł/l, petrol 98 at 6.67 zł/l and diesel at 7.74 zł/l, all lower than the previous caps. Some outlets printed different figures; these are the numbers in the PAP Biznes summary.

items.thread: Poland public finances and credit ratings
items.notes: Closes watch item W-261107-05. Bond yield moves not found.
items.text: The złoty firmed on the first trading day after S&P cut Poland's outlook to negative: EUR/PLN fell below 4.39 (reference 4.3947) as the dollar weakened. S&P also moved Bank Pekao's outlook to negative after the sovereign action.

items.notes: Federal Register notice not yet seen; status of the 178 product exclusions unconfirmed. Updates W-261108-01.
items.text: Trade press reports that the US has formalised a two-month extension of its suspension of Section 301 port fees on China-linked vessels (USTR had proposed running it to Jan 9, 2027). China said it is extending, by two months, its suspension of the extra 24% tariff on US goods and its special port fees; its 10% tariff stays.

Delhi's official 24-hour AQI for Nov 9, the day after Diwali, was 344 ('very poor'); missing monitoring data mean the true figure may be higher (HT estimated about 360). GRAP Stage III, in force since Nov 6, stays; no move to Stage IV. Forecasters expect 'very poor' air on Nov 10-11 and no rain until Nov 15.
